landing.faq1a: PrintSahyogi is a collection of browser-based tools for cropping cards, preparing passport photos, arranging collages, and working with PDFs.
landing.faq2q: How do I crop an Aadhaar card?
landing.faq2a: Open Aadhaar crop, add your file, adjust the crop if needed, then download or print the result.
landing.faq3q: How do I crop an Ayushman card?
landing.faq3a: Choose Ayushman crop, select your card image, and follow the on-screen steps to prepare a print-ready copy.
landing.faq4q: How do I crop a PDF?
landing.faq4a: Open PDF Image Extractor, choose a PDF from your device, select the page or image you need, and save the result.
landing.faq5q: How do I create passport photos?
landing.faq5a: Open Passport Photo Maker, add a portrait, choose the needed size, and create a printable photo sheet.
landing.faq6q: How do I print e-Aadhaar double-sided or on a PVC card?
landing.faq6a: Use the Aadhaar A4 double-side glossy option to arrange both sides for printing. For PVC cards, use the Aadhaar printout tool and follow your printer’s card-printing instructions.
